description: OpenSearch's `_bulk` takes newline-delimited JSON, ending in a newline: the source spec describes it as an array under `application/x-ndjson`, and a JSON array is what the API refuses. The request carries one preserialized `body` string under that media type; `opensearchBulkBody` in `src/opensearch.ts` builds it. Checked against opensearchproject/opensearch:2 (OpenSearch 2.19.7), read 2026-11-01.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The actions as newline-delimited JSON, ending in a newline. Build it with `opensearchBulkBody`.
